The '''''Indomitable''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. The ship participated in the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle of Kothlis]], where it was heavily damaged. After hasty repairs were completed, it was sent to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], where its task force engaged [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==History==
The ship was built in the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]], and incorporated modifications provided by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Its first engagement was to defend the [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] spynet against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The crew dealt with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' new jamming techniques, related to sabotage during construction. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Avrey]], the communications officer, jury-rigged a solution using decades-old technology. The ship's complement of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] routed the enemy, but in the process, took heavy casualties and gained serious damage to the port side of the vessel. The damage limited [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] effectiveness and would place the ship in space-dock for weeks. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], head of the [[Senate Security Committee]] would start a task force to ascertain the cause of the sabotage after the battle.<ref name="Stealth" />

A few weeks later, word of the mission to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] undertaken by the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] reached the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and Senator Organa. In order to rescue the two Jedi and stop [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], who was developing a bioweapon, repairs to the Indomitable were fast-tracked. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sent the ''Indomitable'' to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] with a flotilla consisting of ''[[Pioneer]]'' and ''[[Coruscant Sky]]''. Admiral Yularen was joined by [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] took the [[Dagger/Legends|''Dagger'']] from its patrol in the [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] system and joined the ''Indomitable'' at the pre-approach coordinates.<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

Upon reversion to realspace, the fleet discovered the Separatists had [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] himself was present. Windu ordered Lt. Arey to raise the Jedi Temple on a priority channel. The countermeasures put in place prevented the Separatists from jamming communications again, blocking four attempts during Windu's conversation with Yoda. Yularen and Windu disagreed on the next course of action, but agreed to wait one hour before provoking Grievous.<ref name="Siege" />

In order to rescue Skywalker and Kenobi, Senator Organa had lent a captured Separatist spy ship to Master [[Taria Damsin]]. She planned on using the ship to infiltrate the blockade by faking pursuit by the Republic forces and a subsequent crash-landing. To fool the Separatist fleet into thinking the ship was theirs, the Republic flotilla launched squadrons of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to harass the opposing ships. Master Damsin arrived in the middle and gave out a falsified distress call while she was chased by [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] from the ''Indomitable,'' as well as [[Arrow Squadron]] and [[Hammer Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hammer Squadron]]. She successfully crash-landed on the planet and assisted Skywalker and Kenobi while the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]]
battle continued.<ref name="Siege" />

After fourteen hours of back-and-forth clashes, Admiral Yularen was ready to cut his losses and fall back. Yoda contacted Windu and informed him Senator Organa and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had scraped together a fleet from government and corporate entities to liberate Lanteeb. When the fleet arrived, it numbered eleven [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons and various other ships. Grievous lost his nerve and fled the system, allowing the ''Indomitable'' to launch its complement of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] gunships and take Torrent Company to rescue Skywalker, Kenobi, and Damsin.<ref name="Siege" />

With the battle over, the fleet rested twelve hours over the planet while the aftermath was sorted out. The Jedi left on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to ''Dagger,'' which would return them to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Indomitable'' appears in [[2010]]'s ''Clone Wars Gambit'' duology. The ship is described as a Jedi cruiser, a nickname for [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] during the Clone Wars.
